onboarding.evidenceSubtitle: Upload reusable documents. They stay private and can support future tenders.
onboarding.noDocs: No evidence documents yet. You can add them now or from the Documents page.
onboarding.reviewSubtitle: You can start using BidKaro with the information you have provided.
onboarding.missing: Some fields are still empty. Tender assessments will show which information is missing.
onboarding.saveFailed: We could not save your profile. Check the form and try again.
onboarding.evidenceNote: A document accepted for one tender never automatically satisfies another. Evidence is checked per requirement.

documents.title: Document library
documents.subtitle: Reusable company evidence with its own metadata and verification state.
documents.uploadSubtitle: Files stay private to your company. PDF, PNG or JPG up to 25 MB.
documents.drop: Drop a file here, or browse
documents.supported: PDF, PNG, JPG or JPEG · max 25 MB
documents.deleteBody: The file and its metadata will be removed. This cannot be undone.
documents.emptyBody: Upload registrations, financial statements, completion certificates or other evidence.
documents.fileTooLarge: Files must be 25 MB or smaller.
documents.invalidType: Only PDF, PNG, JPG and JPEG files are accepted.

company.title: Company profile
company.subtitle: The capability and evidence profile used for tender matching.
company.completenessHint: Missing fields are shown as gaps, never treated as failures.
company.missingFields: Complete more fields to strengthen future assessments.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace preferences and account details.
settings.languageHint: Changing language does not change stored records, source text or calculations.
settings.themeHint: Use light or dark mode across the workspace.
settings.securityNote: Documents are served only through authenticated endpoints. Public links are never created.
settings.signOutBody: You will need your email and password to sign back in.

tenders.title: My tenders
tenders.subtitle: Saved tenders and their assessment workspaces.
tenders.emptyBody: Save a tender from Discover tenders to open its assessment workspace.
tenders.notFoundBody: This tender does not exist or does not belong to your company.
tenders.noSummary: No tender summary has been captured yet.

detail.pendingBody: This tender has been saved, but extraction and assessment have not run. Phase 3 will add source-cited requirements, and Phase 4 will add scoring and eligibility.
detail.sourceBody: Original source, retrieval time and collected documents will be shown here with every requirement.

checklist.title: Compliance checklist
checklist.subtitle: Tender-specific tasks with source citations and evidence status.
checklist.emptyBody: Checklist tasks are generated after a tender's requirements are extracted and validated.

changes.title: Changes & alerts
changes.subtitle: Corrigenda, deadline changes and affected requirements.
changes.emptyBody: Once saved tenders are rechecked, source changes and affected tasks will appear here.

discover.title: Discover tenders
discover.subtitle: Search the live web for tenders that match your company profile, with source provenance on every result.
discover.statusBody: Results come from a live TinyFish search and page fetch. Source URLs, retrieval times and retrieval failures are stored with every tender.
discover.unconfiguredBody: Add a TINYFISH_API_KEY to the backend environment to enable live discovery. No sample tenders are ever shown as real results.
discover.runNote: Queries are built from your company profile. Relevance is a profile-fit signal and is separate from mandatory eligibility. Only open tenders with a source-backed closing date or reference are listed; index pages, closed tenders and pages without tender details are kept out.
discover.needProfile: Add sectors, products or keywords to your company profile so discovery has something to match.
discover.emptyBody: This run found no open tender with a source-backed deadline or reference. Index pages, closed tenders and pages without tender details are not listed as tenders — see the sources below.
discover.emptyStored: Run discovery to search the live web for matching tenders.
discover.sourcesHint: Official portals and index pages found during the run. These are not individual tenders, so they are kept out of the tender list.
discover.evidenceNote: Verbatim excerpts extracted from the retrieved source text.
discover.noEvidence: No fields could be extracted from the retrieved text.
discover.fetchNote: Details could not be retrieved from this source ({{reason}}). The listing uses the search snippet only.

errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check that the API is running and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFound: The requested page was not found.
